description: Appointment of an Expert Committee to obtain recommendations to solve issues which have arisen pertaining to the Housing Projects commenced by the National Housing Development Authority during the years 2015-2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - During the period 2015-2019, 2,562 housing projects were planned to be initiated under the National Housing Development Authority, and the total number of houses expected to be constructed under the same was 64,407. Accordingly, the said housing projects had been planned as 1,138 villages under housing assistance, 1,334 villages through housing loans to beneficiaries, and 90 villages under assistance from the Government of India. Nevertheless, out of those, only 386 villages could be completed and opened, and the total number of houses completed is 10,532. It is estimated that an additional provision of Rs.11.26 billion is required to complete the remaining houses. Since it has been observed that various reasons have caused the slow progress of those projects, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to appoint an Expert Committee to analyze matters pertaining to the current status of those projects and identify low-income families who are truly in need of housing, to expeditiously complete the stalled projects and settle the people, and to prepare a formal system for recovering the loans granted, was approved by the Cabinet.
